message: Well, I always say being prepared is like having a good umbrella—you might not need it every day, but when that storm hits, you’ll be glad you have it. I just came across a handy resource on hurricane readiness that’s perfect for brushing up on what to do when the skies turn gray. Just remember, a little preparation can keep the chaos at bay, and maybe even earn you a few smug smiles when the wind starts howling. 🌪️
